author: Little Chinese Everywhere
description:
If you are interested experiencing Yunnan and Chinese Coffee Making yourself, join us on our new tours at: littlechineseeverywhere.com/tours

Deep in Yunnan, near the border with Myanmar, lies the birthplace of one of China’s most special beverages — coffee. While China may be better known for tea, the mountains of Yunnan have been quietly producing coffee for decades.
Using mainly Catimor varieties, Yunnan coffee has developed a distinct character shaped by the region’s high altitude, tropical climate, and diverse landscapes.
We followed the winding Nujiang Valley north to Tengchong, one of Yunnan’s most fascinating coffee regions. Along the way, we visited local coffee farms, met the farmers behind the beans, and explored how China’s coffee culture is growing in the mountains.
